raw_response:
1. The figure does not show any percentage labels, so there’s no way to relate slice percentages to an overall distribution from this chart. It’s a hierarchical sunburst showing principles and sub-principles, but without numeric proportions.

2. The premise is not supported by the figure: “Justice” does not appear to occupy ~40%—“Beneficence” is visually the largest segment, while “Justice” is smaller. Without explicit percentages, only a qualitative comparison is possible (Beneficence > Autonomy/Non-Maleficence > Justice, by visual area).

3. The chart provides no statistical testing results (e.g., p-values, confidence intervals) and no sample size information, so statistical significance cannot be determined. It appears to be a conceptual categorization rather than an inferential/statistical summary.
